summary_en: Gerbera holdings extends tender offer for Metalart Corporation common shares from 2026-06-25 to 2026-07-13 (42 business days total). Tender price ¥7,600/share. Extension provided to allow shareholders additional decision window and accommodate securities report filing and amended offer document requirements.

Correction relates to withdrawal conditions under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Enforcement Regulation Article 14; tender price, share count, and acquisition parameters remain unchanged.
